audit.whatIsWrong: full.phases[].side reads 'Skill' on every row while content.win[] and the packet levelChart both give Tahm Kench levels 1-5 and 2+ items, with only first item even.
audit.why: Poppy is a melee tank with no ranged poke, so Tahm Kench's Thick Skin sustain and Q slow win early trades for free, and R Devour denies her Heroic Charge (E) engage at 6.
audit.corrected: phases[0,1,2,3,4,6].side moved to 'Tahm Kench' to match win[] and the packet chart; matching why text rewritten. phases[5] already matches win[5]='Skill' and is left alone.

audit.why: First item is the one genuine even window because Keeper's Verdict (R, 140/120/100s) comes online alongside Tahm Kench's own R, and 2+ items swings back to Tahm Kench as his tank body blocks the channel.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no real number, and the missingInteractions entry (Keeper's Verdict grants untargetability) is not reflected anywhere in the text.
audit.why: Poppy's R is a channel that also makes her untargetable during the strike, dodging a timed Devour cast — spending R into an active channel wastes it; Steadfast Presence (W) is 20/18/16/14/12s.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with Steadfast Presence's 20-12s cooldown named, and dosFull[2] updated to flag the untargetable window on Keeper's Verdict.
